motivation: Track corresponding body points rather than assuming a translated bounding-box centre. RGB carries texture and dynamics; new pseudo-IR supplies optional foreground geometry.
input_version: Existing November DiffV2IR; no regenerated or substituted auxiliary images
rgb_foreground: Local Lab colour contrast, not a deliberately weakened grayscale-only control
ir_foreground: Polarity-independent scalar contrast in existing pseudo-IR; fallback to RGB foreground if local IR contrast quality <0.15
joint_foreground: Geometric mean of valid RGB and IR foreground support; RGB fallback for unsupported auxiliary input
source_and_target_constraints: Both ends of a point correspondence must belong to the declared foreground; soft exclusive ownership between overlapping candidate regions
point_response: Maximum Shi-Tomasi response across current RGB colour channels
causality: A target update at t uses source pixels and proposals at t-lag and current pixels/proposals at t, never a future frame.
candidate_mechanisms: Body-point transport association instead of box translation
Object-file multi-lag recovery and preservation of previously co-visible objects
acceptance: No innovation credit before complete Dev/Test removal and RGB-only controls. Overall original goal remains >=+5 Test HOTA over direct RGB fine-tune, with 2-3 supported contributions.
calibration_and_selection: Train/Dev only, no Test scores for selection
storage: Past-image deque limited to maximum lag plus current frame in RAM; save compact point-vote arrays, never duplicate whole input videos.
